methodology: WH-Accepted here is TEXT-BASED and requires the Warehouse team's OWN comment (Zoho commenter role 'Warehouse') to contain a genuine first-person admission of fault (e.g. 'we have sent wrong sku', 'we have sent short qty') - not the support agent's or L2's restatement of the customer's complaint, not a request for photo/video evidence (which can contain admission-sounding words like 'wrong medicine' without being an admission), and not the WH team's stock denial ('We have sent proper medicine to Cx'). This is stricter than category alone, so it undercounts relative to the eventual ClickHouse-confirmed return outcome, but gives ops a same-day, defensible WH-admission signal. Location comes from marketplace_orders.warehouse_id joined on order_id (not the internal id column). Fulfilment-chain attribution (picker/packer/qc/manifester) is populated only for WH-Accepted tickets, from warehouse_warehouse_scan_log (picker) and marketplace_order_status_log (packer/qc/manifester status ids 52/61/64).
